passive.name: Rebirth
passive.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

spells.name: Flash Frost
spells.description: Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing magic damage and Chilling enemies for seconds, Slowing them by %. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for seconds and dealing magic damage. Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalPassthroughDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Crystallize
spells.description: Anivia summons a wall of ice units wide. The wall lasts for seconds before it melts.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing magic damage. Against Chilled enemies, Anivia deals magic damage instead.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Glacial Storm
spells.description: Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by % and deals magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over seconds. When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by %, and does magic damage per second instead.
